/societies/cape-orchid-society @1280.text: WC Cape Orchid Society Western Cape Founded 1947 · ~220 membersESTIMATED ABOUT THIS SOCIETY Cape Orchid Society is one of SAOC's 21 affiliated societies, serving growers in Western Cape. Affiliation means the society follows SAOC's national judging standards, its members and plants are eligible to compete at accredited shows country-wide, and it forms part of the federation that has coordinated South African orchid growing since 1968. GENERAL DESCRIPTION — SOCIETY-SPECIFIC DETAIL PENDING CONFIRMATION UPCOMING EVENTS Cape Orchid Society has no upcoming events listed yet. Check the full SAOC calendar for shows and workshops across every affiliated society. View the SAOC events calendar → WHAT TO EXPECT Life at an affiliated orchid society Regular meetings Affiliated societies meet on a regular schedule — usually monthly — combining a plant table, a talk or workshop, and time to trade growing advice with other members. Shows and displays Most societies hold at least one annual show, judged under SAOC’s national standards, and many exhibit at the biennial National Show alongside societies from across the country. Judging and accreditation Members can put plants forward for SAOC judging and work toward accredited judge status through the same national training pathway used at every affiliated society. Beginners welcome No experience is required to attend. Growers at every level — from a first orchid on a windowsill to decades on the show bench — are part of the community. Cape Orchid Society's meeting day, time and venue are not yet confirmed on this site.
